name: How do plumbers detect hidden bathroom leaks?

mainEntity.name: How do plumbers detect hidden bathroom leaks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbers detect hidden bathroom leaks using specialized tools such as moisture meters, thermal imaging cameras, and acoustic listening devices. These tools allow us to pinpoint the source of a leak without unnecessary demolition. For instance, a thermal camera can identify temperature changes behind walls indicating water presence, while a moisture meter confirms the dampness. Accurate detection helps reduce the scope and cost of repairs by minimizing invasive exploratory work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbers use moisture meters, thermal imaging, and acoustic devices to find hidden bathroom leaks non-invasively.
